answer: For river-bank vine growers voting on tide gates, I propose one daily ballot per key after hashcash. Each key signs a nonce; SHA-256 of a canonical encoding of key, day, fresh unpredictable public beacon and nonce must have 40 leading zero bits. Verifiers check the signature, beacon and hash; no valid proof means no ballot that day. Proofs bind to one key: n keys need n*2^40 hash trials/day on average. Hardware rental and ASICs lower costs; wealthy attackers can still buy many identities. This proves work, not unique people or truthful votes.
